All case assignments use our Micro Cases collection. Choose a seminar below or find an application by chapter. [Browse the collection](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/index.html)

[Five seminar assignments](#seminars) · [Cases by chapter](#markets-and-pricing)

## Five case seminars {#seminars}

- [Commit now. Pay for the option to wait? (FIN-22)](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/pay-for-time-to-decide.html) — What information would make paying the reservation fee worthwhile?
- [A price cap. Which shortage remains? (ECO-19)](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/price-cap-shortage-remains.html) — How should the organiser allocate 100 books when the price is capped?
- [One hundred couriers. One hundred matches? (ECO-05)](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/local-matches.html) — How many deliveries can the marketplace match within each district and time window?
- [The biggest order, the smallest cash balance (FIN-03)](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/cash-flow.html) — Which payment terms preserve the workshop’s cash buffer?
- [Two suppliers. One factory? (OPS-05)](https://kochiuyu.github.io/micro-cases/shared-factory.html) — Does splitting orders across distributors protect the buyer if both depend on one factory?
